title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・オブテイン

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide loses the autumn Tenno Sho. Even so, she feels proud of her performance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tears well up in Biwa Hayahide's eyes as she realizes how much she's grown. She's no longer that girl who once lost to her sister and injured herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Together, we've perfected a winning equation to beat her younger sister, Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Only two months remain until we unveil it at the Arima Kinen.
